title: Mary AB Probable NDE 9331
content: I committed suicide Sept 2018. I was dead for a matter of minutes. However, I was brought back. I remember it clearly. I feel mine was different. I felt I was floating in a darkness. I wasn't scared. I had all these feelings like peace, that I was loved I was ok, I was safe. It was warm. It was all my feelings. I couldn't put together thoughts anymore. But others describe seeing tunnel or light. Why was mine so different? I also have had paranormal experiences my whole life my mother (now deceased) told me I had a gift. I blocked a lot out from fear. I was tested and never diagnosed with schizophrenia or a disorder causing hallucinations. I also have vivid dreams at times and sleep paralysis. I have all my life. I also believe I have past lives two I can remember. Background Information: Gender: Female Date NDE Occurred: Sept 8,2018 NDE Elements: At the time of your experience, was there an associated life-threatening event? No. Suicide attemptDrug or medication overdose Clinical death (cessation of breathing or heart function) How do you consider the content of your experience? Neither pleasant NOR distressing Did you feel separated from your body? No I lost awareness of my body How did your highest level of consciousness and alertness during the experience compare to your normal everyday consciousness and alertness? More consciousness and alertness than normal It's a different level hard to explain in text or words. It's an overwhelming amount of feeling. I just WAS At what time during the experience were you at your highest level of consciousness and alertness? Idk. I feel it was a different type of awareness not the same as consciousness we have now even. There was more feeling of things and just knowing. No other thoughts could even be formed Were your thoughts speeded up? No Did time seem to speed up or slow down? No Were your senses More vivid than usual? No Please compare your vision during the experience to your everyday vision that you had immediately prior to the time of the experience. All black. Was just nothing. I felt warm, safe, overwhelming peace. Calm. Floating feeling Please compare your hearing during the experience to your everyday hearing that you had immediately prior to the time of the experience. I didn't hear anything Did you seem to be aware of things going on elsewhere, as if by ESP? No Did you pass into or through a tunnel? No Did you see any beings in your experience? No Did you encounter or become aware of any deceased (or alive) beings? No Did you see, or feel surrounded by, a brilliant light? No Did you see an unearthly light? No Did you seem to enter some other, unearthly world? No What emotions did you feel during the experience? Warmth, safety, calm , peace, love Did you have a feeling of peace or pleasantness? Incredible peace or pleasantness Did you have a feeling of joy? Happiness Did you feel a sense of harmony or unity with the universe? I felt no longer in conflict with nature Did you suddenly seem to understand everything? No Did scenes from your past come back to you? No Did scenes from the future come to you? No Did you come to a border or point of no return? No God, Spiritual and Religion: What was your religion prior to your experience? Do not know Raised Southern Baptist. Studied religion my first time in college so learned Buddhism Muslim etc. I was Mormon, Jehovah witness, pagan and atheist. I've tried them all. Have your religious practices changed since your experience? No What is your religion now? No comment Idk a mix of above. There is a universal energy, a supreme being , good and bad. Idk really Did your experience include features consistent with your earthly beliefs? Content that was entirely not consistent with the beliefs you had at the time of your experience My beliefs have gone back and forth very mixed all my life Did you have a change in your values and beliefs because of your experience? No Did you seem to encounter a mystical being or presence, or hear an unidentifiable voice? No Did you see deceased or religious spirits? No Did you encounter or become aware of any beings who previously lived on earth who are described by name in religions (for example: Jesus, Muhammad, Buddha, etc.)? No During your experience, did you gain information about premortal existence? No During your experience, did you gain information about universal connection or oneness? No During your experience, did you gain information about the existence of God? No Concerning our Earthly lives other than Religion: During your experience, did you gain special knowledge or information about your purpose? Uncertain Because I just knew I was safe I just knew I was loved I just knew the peace. I felt them so strong I just knew. I didn't know any words or thoughts I didn't see or hear anyone. During your experience, did you gain information about the meaning of life? No During your experience, did you gain information about an afterlife? I am uncertain if an afterlife exists No Did you gain information about how to live our lives? No During your experience, did you gain information about life's difficulties, challenges and hardships? No During your experience, did you gain information about love? No What life changes occurred in your life after your experience? Slight changes in my life Have your relationships changed specifically because of your experience? No After the NDE: Was the experience difficult to express in words? Yes It is not an awareness or a logical way to explain. I felt like I was floating, it was all dark. U couldn't put together words or thoughts so u know your separate from the body the brain can't put it together but that's ok. Most NDErs will recognize these overwhelming feelings. How accurately do you remember the experience in comparison to other life events that occurred around the time of the experience? I remember the experience more accurately than other life events that occurred around the time of the experience. Do you have any psychic, non-ordinary or other special gifts after your experience that you did not have before the experience? Uncertain Well I had abilities prior and still do to an extent. Are there one or several parts of your experience that are especially meaningful or significant to you? I will never forget that darkness and the overwhelming emotions Have you ever shared this experience with others? Yes I shared it with a friend about 3 months later and many times since Did you have any knowledge of near death experience (NDE) prior to your experience? Yes They all were people seeing tunnels and light. I felt mine was so different What did you believe about the reality of your experience shortly (days to weeks) after it happened? Experience was definitely real The fact when I woke up at hospital when they said I had been dead. I know what I saw and felt it had to be real. Or maybe an extreme hallucination the brain produces because I was dying. I'm not sure What do you believe about the reality of your experience now? Experience was definitely real I feel it was however It could be something the brain produced. But it was so overwhelming it had to be real At any time in your life, has anything ever reproduced any part of the experience? No

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Floating in darkness with overwhelming feelings of peace, love, safety, warmth; no tunnel, no light, no beings, no life review, no boundary.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Experience described as floating in darkness/blackness with warmth and overwhelming peace/love/safety; no tunnel/light/beings; inability to form thoughts/words during the experience.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “I felt I was floating in a darkness. I wasn't scared.” / “I had all these feelings like peace, that I was loved I was ok, I was safe. It was warm.” / “All black. Was just nothing. I felt warm, safe, overwhelming peace. Calm. Floating feeling.”
